coordinates.locator: centroid of the SPS access building BA4 (CERN building 871, OSM way 68885471); building number to acronym from MapCERN
coordinates.note: Surface building serving the underground hall; the hall itself sits below at an offset no fetched source publishes, hence the precision.

name: SPS Long Straight Section 4 (UA2)
notes: The point is the centroid of the SPS access building BA4 as traced in OpenStreetMap: a campus-grade point, shown as approximate, not a surveyed position of the underground hall. For this reason the UA2 detector has no placement of its own at this site: the link is stated in the text and through the collaboration's host site.

summary.plain: The underground hall on CERN's Super Proton Synchrotron ring where the UA2 detector sat to catch head-on collisions between protons and antiprotons.
summary.technical: One of the SPS's experimental insertion points, conventionally identified as Long Straight Section 4, where UA2 was installed around the beam pipe for the 1981-1990 SppS collider programme.
